Ikast-Brande is a Danish municipality evaluated in the Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK) covering the period from July 1, 2022, to June 30, 2023 [^src1] [^src2]. Published by the Regional Clinical Quality Improvement Programme (RKKP), the report assesses the clinical quality of atrial fibrillation treatments—specifically anticoagulation therapy and safety monitoring—across all 98 Danish municipalities to support local quality development and benchmarking [^src1] [^src2].

Ikast-Brande is notable for meeting the national standard for Indicator 4b, which measures adherence to safety practices when using Direct Oral Anticoagulants (DOACs) [^src1]. The municipality achieved a compliance rate of 95.4% (701 out of 735 eligible patients), successfully placing it above the national threshold of ≥95% [^src1]. 

The municipality is also tracked in other sections of the report detailing further clinical metrics [^src2]. In one such breakdown, Ikast-Brande recorded a rate of 0.4% (4 out of 998) for a specific secondary measure, alongside a related figure of 0.7% (7 out of 990) [^src2]. Together, these data points highlight the municipality's participation in Denmark's decentralized healthcare quality monitoring system [^src1] [^src2].
